import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the provided CSV and total patients by department.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/clinic_ja.csv')
totals = df.groupby('診療科')['患者数'].sum()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.8))
bars = ax.barh(totals.index, totals.values, color='#4C78A8')
ax.set_xlabel('患者数（合計）')
ax.set_ylabel('診療科')
ax.set_title('診療科ごとの患者数合計')
ax.set_xlim(0, max(totals.values) * 1.15)
for bar, value in zip(bars, totals.values):
    ax.text(value + max(totals.values) * 0.015, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
            f'{value}', va='center', ha='left')
ax.grid(axis='x', linestyle='--', alpha=0.35)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
